$schema: Architecture allowlist for Rust-owned runtime math (issue #90)
rule: Shared cross-runtime behavior has one authority: runtime-core (Rust). Other languages consume bindings. Intentional mirrors require an entry here AND a parity contract for their kind: differentiable_mirror/behavioral_mirror must name real executable parity checks; diagnostic/experimental must declare 'none' parity with a reason.

kinds.differentiable_mirror: Differentiable surrogate of Rust-owned math (training gradients flow through it). Real parity checks REQUIRED.
kinds.behavioral_mirror: Non-differentiable behavioral reimplementation. Real parity checks REQUIRED.
kinds.diagnostic: Offline/diagnostic tool, never consumed by training, runtime, or the model. Parity 'none' with reason.
kinds.experimental: Not wired into training or runtime; must not be promoted without a real parity check. Parity 'none' with reason.

mirrors.reason: Differentiable PyTorch surrogates so gradients flow during training. The Rust bindings are non-differentiable; the oracle path (orbit_controller_oracle_sequence / _ContourStep) defers the per-frame contour step to the Rust binding and only the backward pass is a surrogate.
Fallback extractor used when the Rust extractor fails its subprocess sanity check, and for computing dataset normalization stats. Literal numpy port of the Rust formulas.
Test-only mock substituted under vitest (globalThis.__vitest) so frontend unit tests run without loading the wasm binary. Never imported in production code.

Training-time CPU Julia renderer for loss-facing visual metrics (render_julia_set). Rendering-scoped, not controller/feature authority; the distance/proximity metrics delegate to runtime_core.sample_distance_field_py.
GPU (ModernGL) Julia renderer for training-time visual metrics with CPU fallback. Rendering-scoped; optional (--no-gpu-rendering bypasses it).
Diagnostic-only plotting: cardioid/bulb outlines and an escape-time background grid for the c-trace figure. Never consumed by training, runtime, or the model.
parity: none (diagnostic-only; excluded from runtime paths by review)

mirrors.reason: EXPERIMENTAL live-performance controller (only referenced by backend/examples/live_controller_demo.py). Computes a separate analysis vocabulary (mel bands, tonalness, onset rate) that is NOT the canonical features/2 contract. Not wired into training or the runtime; must not become one without either delegating to runtime_core.FeatureExtractor or registering a real parity check.
parity: none (experimental; see reason â€” do not promote without parity)
